svg.title: The life-crm framework
svg.desc: One Google Sheet in the middle. You chat with an assistant and see a dashboard, both working from the sheet. An AI agent builds and updates it from your sources and keeps its work in a workspace. Everything is private; a Cloudflare login guards the dashboard, and an optional public page sits outside.
